## Outcome

Evidence-backed contributions to instrumentation, AAIF terminology, and OTel GenAI conventions.

Task 9 of the nine-task Agent Behavior Trace Model execution plan following the August WG discussions.

**Why:** The examples should lead to improvements in shared conventions and instrumentation, with a path away from experimental extensions.

**Work:** Discuss findings with maintainers during design. Send runtime fixes to their owners, vocabulary proposals to AAIF Taxonomy & Landscape, and telemetry guidance or semantic changes to OTel GenAI. Explain alternatives and migration for any proposed extension.

**Example:** If a runtime already has a conversation ID but omits it from telemetry, contribute an instrumentation fix. If both examples leave consumers unable to identify a turn's entry span consistently, bring the failing cases to the existing OTel discussion and test a proposed resolution.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Done when:** agreed contributions are submitted with supporting examples and linked from WG work tracking. Acceptance and release remain separate milestones.

## Tracking

- **Workstream:** Agent Behavior Trace Model
- **Owner:** needs owner
- **Status:** needs owner
- **Next step:** Find a coordination owner and bring the baseline findings to the relevant maintainers during contract design.
- **Depends on:** Discussion starts during [Task 3](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/41); submissions draw on [Task 5](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/43), [Task 6](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/44), [Task 7](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/45), [Task 8](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/46).
